newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET MONDAY MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS QUIET MONDAY MIXED.

text.p: Zimbabwe's interbank market registered very thin trade on Monday with the local unit closing firmer on the U.S. dollar and the rand but softer against European currencies.
"There were about two banks that ended up quite long -- I don't know where they got the money from -- and they were selling in the market," one dealer said.
"But no-one really wanted the money so everyone was quoting low (exchange rates)," he added.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the day at 11.3085/3185 against the U.S. unit from 11.3150/3250 in the morning and late Friday and firmed to 2.5390/5585 from 2.5400/5600 on the rand.
Against sterling however it weakened to 18.3360/3590 from 18.2300/2500, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas and was at 6.5515/5590 from 6.5500/5700 versus the mark.
